extra_examples.zh: 我们参观农场。然后，我们回家。

teaching.student_prompt: 你放学后先做什么？再用 afterwards 说说接下来做什么。
teaching.cloze_zh: 我们吃午饭。然后，我们去玩。
teaching.note: 先读单词与例句，再用 word_study 学习来源和构成；关联例句均为原创。

word_study.explanation_zh: -ward 表示方向；afterwards 把方向用在时间上，表示“后来”。这里的 -s 不是复数。
word_study.origin_zh: 古英语 æfterweard 有“在后面、跟在后面”的意思。后来也用来表示时间上的“之后”，并出现带 -s 的形式。

family.connection_zh: 和 backwards 一样带 -wards，表示方向。

challenge.prompt_zh: afterwards 和 backwards 中的 -ward(s) 通常表示什么？afterwards 指空间还是时间？
challenge.answer_zh: 方向；afterwards 指时间上的“后来”。

images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: classroom vocabulary/story photograph for Chinese primary-school KET learners, shown large on a projector.
Style: beautiful, playful, predominantly photorealistic natural editorial educational photography; bright daylight, rich but plausible colors, realistic skin, real materials, correct anatomy, warm humour. Uncluttered composition with a strong main subject and high visual quality. Landscape 3:2 composition, ideally 1536 by 1024.
Global constraints: no embedded text, letters, captions, logos, watermarks, UI labels, decorative frames, cartoons or clipart. All children are fictional, ordinary fully clothed, in benign learning scenes. Natural plausible scale and perspective. Friendly safe environments.
Recurring characters whenever named: Mia is a fictional East Asian girl about 9, black ponytail, coral-red light jacket, pale-blue jeans, white trainers. Ben is a fictional East Asian boy about 9, short black hair. In farm-story scenes Ben wears a child-size blue two-piece formal suit, white shirt, yellow rain boots. A recurring lizard is a small vivid green realistic garden lizard, long tail, four anatomically correct legs, not a chameleon.

Primary request: a clear before/afterwards sequence made of exactly two equal photographic panels side by side, separated only by a small clean white gutter. The SAME fictional East Asian boy about 9 with short black hair wears the same blue school jumper in both panels, in a sunny school environment. LEFT panel: the boy at a school picnic table finishing lunch, looking at his plate with a few remaining lunch pieces. RIGHT panel: later the same boy happily playing football with a soccer ball on the school grass. Each panel has one strong unmistakable action. No arrows, no words, no panel labels. Meaning to convey without rendering words: We eat lunch. Afterwards, we play.
